subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw expose all five memory role slots now, or narrow this PR to roles with complete lifecycle and per-agent invocation semantics?
rationale: This PR adds durable public plugin and configuration APIs, but capture, dreaming, and user-model roles lack complete agent-scoped invocation contracts, so implementation alone cannot safely determine the permanent product surface.

options.title: Narrow to implemented roles
options.body: Ship recall and compaction now, and track capture, dreaming, and user-model lifecycle APIs as explicit follow-up work.

options.title: Complete all five roles
options.body: Retain the broad contract but add explicit invocation APIs and per-agent routing for every advertised role before merge.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers redesign the memory plugin contract before accepting new configuration keys.

recommendation.title: Narrow to implemented roles
recommendation.body: Ship recall and compaction now, and track capture, dreaming, and user-model lifecycle APIs as explicit follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history places the central plugin-slot, memory-runtime, configuration, and dreaming surfaces under his recent work, making him the strongest available owner for this product/API decision.
